Name: Larger Fishing Farm Map (Riverland Edit)
Author: Xezarior
Description:
[size=4]Description[/size]
To clarify the title: this map edit does not increase the total size in [i]tiles[/i] (squares) of the map.

Instead, it changes the land-to-water ratio, in order to provide more usable surface for the farm while maintaining the look and feel of the fishing farm map ("Riverland"). This is achieved by drawing the islands wider and merging them partly together, at the cost of some river area.

No objects or other map data has been moved. The fishing rate should remain the same as in the base map.
The newly created soil area is fully tillable and buildable, and includes data for debris spawn (wood, plants, trees...). Therefore the additional surfaces won't stay magically clean if you don't tend to them.

This map edit is intended for people who want to play on the Riverland map and wish for more room for farm organisation, but who also don't want to switch to extreme maps like the capitalist dream map.
You can also install the mod and use it in an already existing save on the Riverland map. For that, you only need to take care of emptying water tiles (e.g. remove crab pots) before installing the mod, so they don't land in the new soil areas.
Please note that if installed/activated, this mod will apply to all saves that use the Riverland farm. To use it on a new save, just create a new save and choose the Riverland farm.
You can deactivate it at any time, as long as you have cleaned the additional areas beforehand, and moved buildings away from them. It is therefore compatible with the base map.

I created this map for myself because I got frustrated by the very little possibilities to place buildings and make "orderly" crop fields in the original Riverland map. Also, I was new to nexusmods in general at the time, so I hadn't found the other similar mods (look below under "See also").

[size=4]Installation and Dependencies[/size]
For the correct versions, please refer to the version notes. To use this mod, you need to:
[list=1]
[*]Update Stardew Valley to the version [b]listed below[/b].
[*][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_SMAPI]Install SMAPI[/url]﻿ with the version [b]listed below[/b].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915﻿﻿]Install ContentPatcher[/url]﻿ with the version [b]listed below[/b].

[*]Find your game folder (see the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]wiki explanation[/url]﻿ on how to do that).

[*]Place the contents of the zip file under your mod folder (also [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_mods]explained in the wiki[/url]﻿ right below finding the game folder).
[/list][code]...\Stardew Valley\Mods\
├───ContentPatcher
│       ...
│
└───[CP] XezariorsLargerFishingFarmMap
    │   content.json
    │   manifest.json
    │
    └───assets
            Farm_Fishing.tmx
[/code][size=4]
[/size]
[size=4]Version Notes and Changelog
[/size]
[center][font=Georgia][size=3]﻿[b]• v1.0.0: (2023-07[/b][/size][b][size=3]-02) Initial release •[/size][/b][/font][/center](Made with Content Patcher version 1.29.0.)[i][size=3]

[/size][/i][b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley version [u]1.5.6[/u] or [b][i]less[/i][/b]
[*]SMAPI version [u]2.0[/u] or higher
[*]ContentPatcher version [u]1.30.4[/u] or [b][i]less[/i][/b]
[/list]
[i]Note[/i]: I updated my game and tools to versions SV 1.6.8, SMAPI 4.0.8 and CP 2.3.0 respectively, and did not encounter any warp bugs. The map is playable in 1.6.8 at least, but the changes made to the map data (such as building areas etc.) are missing.[list]
[/list][b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]Apparently, this mod version does work with Stardew Valley version 1.6.8 or higher, but it is not fully tested and you may encounter bugs.
[*]The tree at the upper left corner of the map does not become transparent when the player walks behind it. I could not find a way to fix this.
[*]I did not find the time and energy to repack the map, therefore you can only use this mod with the content patcher.
[/list].

[center][font=Georgia][size=3][b]• v1.1.0: (2024-11-11) Fix for 1.6 update •[/b][/size][/font][/center]
I remade the map from "scratch" using the map delivered with Stardew Valley version 1.6.8 and drew the changes anew. Therefore, some graphical changes where made, but the topographical changes should be identical to version 1.0.0.

[/list][i]Note[/i]: I made and tested the changes using both software versions: [Stardew Valley 1.6.8, SMAPI 4.0.8 and CP 2.3.0]; as well as [Stardew Valley 1.6.13, SMAPI 4.1.6 and CP 2.4.0].
[b]

[font=Georgia][size=3][b][center]﻿[font=Georgia][size=3][b]• v1.1.1: (2025-03-29) Collision fix centre south •[/b][/size][/font][/center]

Please note that this removes 1x10 tiles of tillable and buildable area (coordinates (28,68) to (37,68)).

[size=4]License[/size]
Feel free to further edit the map file as you wish. However, I kindly ask you to refer to this page should you publish any further changes based on this map edit.
Please do not reupload this mod elsewhere.


[size=4]How to Contribute[/size]
I do not plan to continue modding actively, this is a very occasional edit of mine.

If you notice any bugs, problems or improvement possibilities, feel free to use the discussion/bug-report tools provided by NexusMods.
Please keep in mind that I may not be very active on here, but I will take care of checking in at least once a month.

I am looking for help to make the tree in the upper left corner transparent when the player moves behind it.

I will gladly take in any questions or remarks on this description, so that I can expand it if necessary. If you have any requests, be they either of technical or preferential nature, don't hesitate to contact me here on NexusMods.


[size=4]Creation process (v1.0.0)
[/size]To create this edit, I followed the very good modding guides on the stardew wiki ([url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Maps]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Maps[/url]). Fore more details, please refer to those.
[list=1]
[*]Unpack the game files into a new folder (e.g. "Content (unpacked)"). Feel free to limit it to only the subfolders you want to edit.
[*]Make a working copy of the folder (e.g. "Content (Editing)")
[*]Open the map file in [url=https://www.mapeditor.org/]the map editor Tiled[/url] ("...\Stardew Valley\Content (Editing)\Maps\Farm_Fishing.tmx")
[*]Edit the map and save.
[*]Copy the edited map to the mod folder ("...\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] XezariorsLargerFishingFarmMap\assets\")
[*]Create the required files for the content patcher ("content.json", "manifest.json")
[/list]
